```{r}

library(kableExtra)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

c(
  "time_and_date_functions.R",
  "utility_functions.R",
  "scheduling_functions.R"
) %>% 
  walk(
    ~ here("scripts/utils/functions", .x) %>% 
      source()
  )

# get and process data ----------------------------------------------------

schedule <- prep_schedule_data()

schedule_list <-
  schedule %>% 
  split(schedule$day)

schedule_updates <- 
  here("data", "schedule_updates.rds") %>% 
  read_rds() %>% 
  mutate(date = as_date(date))

# list set-up -------------------------------------------------------------

day_names <- 
  c(
    Mon = "Monday",
    Tue = "Tuesday",
    Wed = "Wednesday",
    Thu = "Thursday",
    Fri = "Friday",
    Sat = "Saturday"
  )

days_ordered <- 
  intersect(
    names(day_names),
    names(schedule_list)
  )

day_data <- 
  days_ordered %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(
    \(day) {
      day_data <- 
        schedule_list[[day]] %>% 
        select(
          date,
          arrive:helper
        ) %>% 
        distinct()
    }
  )

```

# Weekly schedule: `r pretty_date_range(schedule)`

```{r results="asis"}

days_ordered %>% 
  iwalk(
    function(.wday, .i) {
      day_block(.wday)
      if (.i %% 2 == 0 && .i < length(days_ordered)) {
        cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
      }
    }
  )

```
